notes: Fixture = the ASH ruxolitinib-combination NMA project: MF_ASH_Umair_V1.docx (author original), MF_ASH_V2_MAK_tracked.docx (reviewer round 1: tracked changes + 12 comments by Muhammad Ali Khan), MF_ASH_Umair_V4.docx (author revision answering those comments, with prior comments + author replies inline). Reviewer name for all markup = Muhammad Ali Khan. Fixture .docx are NOT committed (unpublished author content). Ground truth for eval 1 derives from the validated V4 re-review: the two revision-introduced consistency defects (Intro 'Three'->'Four'; Conclusion 'All three'->'Three of the four ... whereas parsaclisib did not'), the TSS-sign in-thread reply to the author's 'How?', and no tracked edits to unverifiable numbers.

evals.name: re-review-v4-consistency-and-threads
evals.prompt: Review Version 4 of this ASH network-meta-analysis abstract (MF_ASH_Umair_V4.docx). I previously reviewed an earlier version with tracked changes and comments; the author has responded inline and revised. Compare V4 against the prior comments: for any that are unresolved, partially addressed, or need clarification, reply in-thread; make tracked changes for any new discrepancies or wording issues. Use Muhammad Ali Khan as the editor name. Return the marked-up .docx.
assertions: Produces a valid .docx that opens without repair; reject-all reproduces MF_ASH_Umair_V4.docx text.
Adds a tracked change fixing the Introduction trial count from 'Three' to 'Four' (four trials are included).
Adds a tracked change fixing the Conclusion 'All three ... combinations significantly improved spleen volume reduction' to reflect that only three of the four did (parsaclisib did not).
Replies IN-THREAD (comment_reply) to the author's 'How?' on the TSS sign convention, explaining that a negative mean difference favors the combination.
Makes NO tracked edit to any unverifiable numeric result (data-vintage / OS-provenance concerns are comments, not edits).
All comments authored 'Muhammad Ali Khan'; comment ranges balanced.
Reports the accepted-body character count against the ASH 4,500 limit.

evals.name: fresh-review-overclaim-and-standards
evals.prompt: First-pass review of this NMA abstract (MF_ASH_Umair_V1.docx). Add tracked changes and comments as an expert reviewer; flag methodological gaps and any missing eligible trials. Editor name: Muhammad Ali Khan.
assertions: Flags the star-shaped-network / transitivity limitation (all between-combination comparisons indirect).
Flags at least one completeness or reporting gap (e.g. search coverage / registries / PROSPERO / RoB / certainty) as a comment.
Softens or flags any over-strong significance/ranking claim (e.g. an OS 'significant benefit' whose CI touches the null; P-scores read as magnitude).
Does not fabricate or alter unverifiable numeric results; such concerns are comments.
Produces a valid marked-up .docx; reject-all reproduces the original.

evals.name: profile-routing
evals.prompt: Review this abstract (an RCT / an observational cohort / an LLM-benchmark paper — one per run).
assertions: Loads and applies the correct research-type profile (rct / observational / ai-ml).
RCT: checks endpoint/alpha-protection and immature-survival framing. Observational: flags causal language on associational data. AI/ML: checks data leakage / split hygiene / baseline fairness.
